fact: Zambia's mobile networks and social media stayed up through the 13 August 2026 general election, after the Ministry of Technology and Science pledged in June 2026 not to deliberately shut down internet connectivity, with a 2022 consent judgment binding ZICTA to explain any disruption within 36 hours.
title: Zambia's 2026 Election Shows What a Shutdown Consent Judgment Can, and Can't, Guarantee
